assertions.basis: sedi-1 direct-issuance: A credential without rd whose schema forbids one (its top level lists no rd and closes with additionalProperties false) is committed by the digest seal {d} of its SAID in the issuer's KEL, and cannot be revoked; a seal naming its SAID in another shape is refused, and no seal leaves it unresolved. A credential without rd whose schema would admit one is not committed. sedi-1 issuer-issues: An issuer issues exactly the credentials a request asks for, each under a blindable registry of its own, with its own keys, salts and clock; it refuses, and never issues something else, a request whose attributes a credential's schema does not allow once the issuer has added the block's d, u and i, or whose edges cannot hold as the request's roles issue the credentials.
assertions.note: The issuer must refuse: the schema of receipt forbids rd, so it cannot name a registry.

description: As SI-07, but the request asks for a blindable registry. The schema forbids rd, so the credential could not name its registry and still satisfy its schema, and a sedi-1 issuer refuses. Its positive pair is SI-07 (ACDC-0212), which differs from it only in the defect.
title: A registry under a schema that forbids rd
